Subject: Redwood product walkthrough — initial scheduling

Hi Maya / Alex —

Great to meet you on the phone yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd love to set up a 45 minute walkthrough where Ben (AE) will cover business fit and pricing, and Soojin (SE) will demo the product and cover security/infra questions. Priyom (solutions) will join for any procurement/contract items.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 21: 9:00–9:45 AM
- Tue Jul 21: 2:30–3:15 PM
- Wed Jul 22: 11:00–11:45 AM

If none of those work, send 2 windows that do and we'll align. Also attaching a short agenda and a requested evidence checklist for your security/procurement team so they can skim in advance.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next steps: pick a slot and we'll send a calendar invite with Dial-in + recording disabled by default.

Thanks —

ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Ben — appreciate the options. Quick notes:
- I'll be the champion on our side and can make the Tue Jul 21 2:30–3:15 PM slot.
- Alex (engineering lead) is with customers on Tue morning but is available Wed Jul 22 11:00–11:45 AM. He flagged that we should include our security contact (cc'd procurement for procurement redlines) so they can see the evidence checklist.

Procurement: procurement@cypherworks.com, can you confirm if you need any additional paperwork before we confirm the demo?

If it's helpful, we can aim for Wed Jul 22 11:00–11:45 AM PT — Alex's calendar looks best there. Otherwise, we can do Tue afternoon without Alex and loop him in for a follow-up technical deep dive.

Thanks Maya — good call to prioritize Alex for the initial run if possible. A couple of quick asks from our side to make the session productive:

- If Wed Jul 22 11:00–11:45 AM PT works for Alex, we'll make that the primary slot.
- Can procurement confirm required PO/contract timeline so we know whether to include our legal contact on the calendar?
- Soojin and I will prepare a short security slide deck and the SOC2 evidence list (attached) — Maya, feel free to share any internal policies we should be aware of ahead of time.

I'll stand up the calendar invite once Ben confirms Soojin's availability and any adjustments to the agenda.
